name: Jinchiku Wakusei ~Bijin Shimai ga Mayoikonda no wa Ningen ga Doubutsu no Kachiku ni Naru Wakusei Deshita~
original_name: 人畜惑星～美人姉妹が迷い込んだのは人間が動物の家畜になる惑星でした～
source: We invite you to the world where animals have come to dominate humans-the zoonotic planet.
translation: We invite you to the world where animals have come to dominate humans-the zoonotic planet.
